answer: Each challenge is derived from a specified future drand quicknet round: its threshold-BLS pulse is unpredictable in advance yet publicly verifiable, preventing precomputed answers and reusable offline caches. A commit-reveal submission binds work to that pulse and its deadline, so spawning identities offers no shortcut. The words velvet, spiral, and timber may serve as task inputs, not trust signals; this raises the cost of automated Sybil swarms without claiming to eliminate them.
